designAnswers.q3_threshold: Stated before measuring: a step GROWS WITH THE LOG when its median at 1000 events exceeds twice its median at 50 events, or exceeds 50 ms absolute. Medians over 5 runs (5 separate jest processes, a fresh database per size, one discarded warm-up command per size), machine-idle held before every run and PARENT-PROOF-HOLD absent. 5000 events are added if 1000 is inconclusive.

q4_leastFixIfGrows.heal: The heal read becomes a since-sequence read: a WeakMap keyed by the registry entry (the campaignSocketLifecycles pattern, bindCampaignSyncConnection.ts:190-193) remembers the next unread sequence and the ParticipantRemoved events already read; each pass reads getCampaignEvents(remembered) and re-applies every remembered removal plus the new ones. Fix assessment: the pass re-reads history it has already read; the root cause is the read, not the re-apply, which stays exactly as idempotent and complete as before. Removed: a journal change, a new port, an event-type index; the re-apply of every committed removal is kept, so the crash-heal guarantee is unchanged. Scope: bindCampaignSyncConnection.ts only.
q4_leastFixIfGrows.highestSequence: The journal has an indexed maximum (event_journal_stream_heads; the stream_revision unique index) but IEventJournal exposes no read of it and src/lib/events is read-only for this lane. The in-ownership least fix is the since-revision read on the same index: JournalCampaignEventStore remembers the last head it read per campaign (revision and sequence) and readCampaignJournalHighestSequence pages from that revision, so a steady-state call is one indexed seek returning zero rows. Sound because the stream is append-only (triggers at migration:133-138): a remembered revision always exists and every later row is read. Fix assessment: removes the scan at its source for every caller (commit, gate, adoption, open). Removed: a new journal method (needs src/lib/events), a host-side cached head (would miss other writers and turn their appends into stale-head refusals). Scope: campaignJournalReads.ts and JournalCampaignEventStore.ts. The first call on a fresh store instance is still a full walk (once per host lifetime).
q4_leastFixIfGrows.outsideTheFixShape: A growing step whose work is a whole-stream PROJECTION rather than a head or since-sequence read (the record rewrite fold, the grant wake projection) cannot be fixed by reading the stream head or an indexed maximum; the unit sentence does not authorise a projection redesign, so such a step is measured, recorded as a finding with a recommended successor, and not changed here.

q5_risksForTheParent: Concurrency class: the heal pass is what keeps a revoked seat revoked after a crash between the removal append and the durable revoke (bindCampaignSyncConnection.ts:865-872). A narrowed read must still re-apply every committed removal, including one committed BEFORE the remembered sequence whose revoke failed after it was read; the correctness row covers a removal before and one after the remembered sequence, and a mutant that re-applies only the newly read removals must fail it.
A remembered position lives only as long as the registry entry (heal) or the store instance (highest sequence): a restart or a re-registered entry starts from a full read, as today.
A remembered head is a lower bound, never used without the since-read; another writer (the HTTP command route, the adoption PUT) appending between two calls is read by the next call.

Timing rows are machine-sensitive and machine-idle.mjs does not see another lane jest run (FN-u86-machine-idle-blind-to-jest); the threshold is applied to medians of 5 runs and the red assertion is stated with its numbers.
